# Atrax

Cloud for your company’s apps. Company-only by default; existing agents use the same authorized operations.

- [Start with Atrax](https://atrax.run/agents.md): Install the matching CLI skill and build or resume an app.
- [Quickstart](https://atrax.run/docs/quickstart/index.md): Create an app, run it locally, and share it with your company.
- [CLI reference](https://atrax.run/docs/cli/index.md): One CLI for app creation, deployment, company knowledge, and agent operations.
- [App contract](https://atrax.run/docs/app-contract/index.md): One version 2 artifact runs locally and in the hosted environment.
- [Infrastructure model](https://atrax.run/docs/infrastructure-model/index.md): What Atrax owns and how releases retain app identity.
- [Chat example](https://atrax.run/docs/chat-example/index.md): A small persistent app with two named actions.
- [Inventory and Orders](https://atrax.run/docs/inventory-orders/index.md): Two company apps perform one business operation with explicit recovery.
- [Apps](https://atrax.run/docs/apps/index.md): Build and deploy workspace-owned apps.
- [Database](https://atrax.run/docs/database/index.md): Persistent structured data for each app.
- [Access](https://atrax.run/docs/access/index.md): Verified company access, app sharing, and revocable agent sessions.
- [Library](https://atrax.run/docs/library/index.md): Company files and guidance that authorized people and agents can share.
- [Actions](https://atrax.run/docs/actions/index.md): Named app actions that preserve the employee’s permissions.
- [MCP](https://atrax.run/docs/mcp/index.md): Use your existing agent through the official MCP stdio protocol.
- [Automation](https://atrax.run/docs/automation/index.md): Hosted agents and scheduled automation are planned.
- [Security model](https://atrax.run/docs/security/index.md): Identity and permissions stay outside uploaded app code.
- [Feature status](https://atrax.run/docs/status/index.md): The first launch focuses on a complete company app workflow.

- [Operation schemas](https://atrax.run/operations.json)
